title: Much cult is titles and eulogies—Mary called Queen, Door of heaven, Refuge of sinners, ‘by thee the world is saved’
source_text: LXI. Praeterea bona pars cultus quem Sanctis deferre solent in Ecclesia Romana consistit in laudibus, titulis, atque elogiis, quibus illos ornare intendunt, quaeque in suis precibus & hymnis, ac quibuslibet suae devotionis libris magno studio accumulant. Quo genere honoris Beatam praecipue Virginem prosequuntur. Itaque passim illam in suis hymnis atque Litaniis vocant absolute Reginam, & Dominam. Reginam coeli, Reginam & Dominam mundi: Reginam Angelorum: Imo Monarcham inclytam. Vocant illam matrem Misericordiae, Matrem gratiae, & Fontem omni gratia scatentem. Item, Januam coeli, Foelicem caeli portam, Foenicem Paradisi, Foederis arcam, Stellam Maris, Stellam Matutinam, Salutem infirmorum, Refugium peccatorum, Auxilium Christianorum, Lucem mundi pellentem cuncta schismata. Ibidem salutatur, spes mundi, spes & vita nostra, & lux cuncta schismata & quaeque nubila pellens. Illi etiam dicitur: Per te Mundus salvatus est: Per te sursum levatus est: Per te jam mors damnata est: Per te vita donata est. Quorum singulorum exempla reperiuntur, tum in ordinariis Sanctae Virginis Litaniis, tum in hymnis Ecclesiasticis, cum libro Psalmorum impressis Parisiis apud Gulielmum Chaudiere anno 1582. Ubi quoque reperiuntur hymni superius citati.
pass_a_gloss: Moreover a good part of the cult which they are accustomed to pay to the Saints in the Roman Church consists in praises, titles, and eulogies with which they intend to adorn them, and which they accumulate with great zeal in their prayers and hymns and in any books of their devotion. With which kind of honor they especially pursue the Blessed Virgin. And so everywhere in their hymns and Litanies they call her absolutely Queen and Lady. Queen of heaven, Queen and Lady of the world: Queen of Angels: Nay, renowned Monarch. They call her mother of Mercy, Mother of grace, and Fountain abounding with every grace. Likewise, Door of heaven, Happy gate of heaven, Phoenix of Paradise, Ark of the covenant, Star of the Sea, Morning Star, Health of the sick, Refuge of sinners, Help of Christians, Light of the world driving away all schisms. There she is also saluted as hope of the world, our hope and life, and light driving away all schisms and every cloud. It is also said to her: Through thee the World has been saved: Through thee it has been lifted up: Through thee now death has been damned: Through thee life has been given. Examples of each of which are found both in the ordinary Litanies of the Holy Virgin and in Ecclesiastical hymns printed with the book of Psalms at Paris at Guillaume Chaudière’s in the year 1582. Where also the hymns cited above are found.
pass_b_english: Much Roman Saint-cult is piled titles and eulogies—especially Mary’s.
She is absolute Queen, Door of heaven, Refuge of sinners, Help of Christians.
Hymns even say: through her the world is saved and life given.

choices.english: Through thee the World has been saved
choices.why: Strong Marian soteriological elogium Le Blanc catalogs.
